{{Quote|So, General Grievous, we meet at last. In the name of the Republic, I&mdash;urrrk!|Jedi Master Sannen, during the battle|<ref name="Droids" />}}
The '''Battle of Parein II 4''' occurred in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Taking place on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Parein II 4/Legends|Parein II 4]], the chaotic battle pitted the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] against [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]] led by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Sannen/Legends|Sannen]] and [[Tyneir Renz]]. The conflict saw the military debut of Grievous's [[Tsmeu-6 personal wheel bike]] and his [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]]. It resulted in the utter destruction of the Republic forces; Sannen was killed by a MagnaGuard and the Jedi [[Valin Draco]] was left for dead.

==Prelude==
The [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] served as [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the Separatists and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The general desired to lead his [[Army/Legends|army]], including its [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|IG-227 ''Hailfire''-class droid tanks]], in a full-frontal assault. To do so, Grievous modified a [[Tsmeu-6 personal wheel bike]] into an [[Armor/Legends|armored]] combat vehicle and added a [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]] [[Nd-53 double laser cannon/Legends|nd-53 double laser cannon]].<ref name="Lord" />

==The battle==
[[File:GrievousWheelBike-WSMI.png|thumb|right|250px|Grievous debuted his Tsmeu-6 personal wheel bike during the battle.]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] into the Clone Wars, Grievous led the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] against [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by<ref name="Lord" /> the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]<ref name="Droids" /> [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Sannen/Legends|Sannen]]<ref name="Lord" /> and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]<ref name="CSWE Renz">{{CSWECite|III|93|Renz, Colonel Tyneir}}</ref> [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Tyneir Renz]] in battle on [[Parein II 4/Legends|Parein II 4]],<ref name="Lord" /> the fourth [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Parein II/Legends|Parein II]]<ref name="Echoes" /> in the [[Sarin sector/Legends|Sarin sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> In the first battlefield use of Grievous's wheel bike,<ref name="Starships" /> the general led a charge that crushed the Republic opposition.<ref name="Lord" /> Sannen confronted Grievous for the first time and<ref name="Droids" /> bravely<ref name="Fact File 13">{{FactFile2014|13|MAG 1-2|Grievous' MagnaGuards}}</ref> attempted to subdue him, but was interrupted by<ref name="Droids" /> being [[Death/Legends|fatally]] jabbed in the throat by one of Grievous's [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]], who also made their debut in the conflict.<ref name="Sony" /> The Republic forces were utterly destroyed<ref name="Starships" /> and the Jedi [[Valin Draco]] was injured during the chaotic battle.<ref name="Echoes" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|During the Clone Wars, the brave men and women I commanded called me the ‘Valiant Dragon’ as we fought in epic conflicts for the corrupt Republic. But after I was left for dead on the battlefield of Parein II 4, flattering titles lost their meaning for me.|Valin Draco|<ref name="Echoes" />}}
[[File:Draco_New.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Valin Draco was wounded in the battle and later became an Imperial Inquisitor.]]
Left for dead and stranded, Draco was stalked by a [[Maalraas|nighthunter]], a creature that used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to seek its prey. In a vicious duel that nearly killed both participants, the creature bit off Draco's [[Limb/Legends|thumb]] and clamped its jaws around his [[Throat/Legends|throat]], but the Jedi was able to ultimately able to wound and subdue it. He subsequently nursed it to health and formed a bond, naming it [[Crant]]. Draco also rejected the Jedi afterward and was believed to be dead.<ref name="Echoes" /> Renz also survived the battle.<ref name="CSWE Renz" />

Grievous was pleased with the results of the use of his wheel bike and had several others fashioned for his MagnaGuards. He continued to use his vehicle until it was destroyed in the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]]<ref name="Lord" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> in which Grievous also perished.<ref name="Lord" /> Following the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] of the Clone Wars, the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Declaration of a New Order|transformation]] of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Draco reemerged as a member of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]], an order of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] that hunted Jedi for the Empire. He recalled his fate at the Battle of Parein II 4 to a group of heroes on the planet [[Almas]]<ref name="Echoes" /> in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].<ref name="Almas date">"[[Echoes of the Jedi]]" states that [[Vhiin Thorla]] traveled to the [[Almas Academy]] two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the declaration of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which is dated to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', Therefore, [[Valin Draco]]'s encounter with the heroes must have taken place in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Parein II 4 was first mentioned in "[[The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War]]," an article written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and published online on [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club]] on [[February 15]], [[2006]].<ref name="Lord" />
